title: Reducedness after tensoring with an algebraic closure is independent of the chosen closure
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $A$ be a commutative $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], and let $\bar k/k$ be any algebraic closure [def-weil-algebraic-closure]. Then $A\otimes_k\bar k$ is reduced if and only if $A\otimes_k\operatorname{AlgebraicClosure}(k)$ is reduced, where $\operatorname{AlgebraicClosure}(k)$ is Mathlib’s canonical algebraic closure.

source.place: Tag 09GV (algebraic closures are isomorphic over the base field), with tensor-product transport of reducedness
